_about: Pilot portraits v2 (STYLE-GUIDE 7, LANCE-32). One locked template (camera, light, background, wardrobe language), only the person varies. Qwen-Image t2i, seed crc32(name)+reseed. Rendered by tools/art/portraits_v2.py.
prompt: Gritty digital painting character portrait for a military science-fiction strategy game, painterly with visible brushwork, slightly desaturated muted palette, not photorealistic, not cartoon. Medium portrait from the waist up, the camera well back so the head fills only about a quarter of the frame height and a wide band of dark empty backdrop surrounds the head and shoulders, three-quarter view: the face turned only about thirty degrees to the left of the camera, so both eyes and both sides of the nose are clearly visible and the gaze is just past the viewer, the eyes level in the upper third of the frame. Dark muted blue-grey gradient background, warm amber key light on the face from the front left, a thin cool pale-blue rim light along the edge of the hair and shoulder. A {age} {ethnicity} {gender}, {build}, {face}, {hair}, {expression}. {wardrobe}
